summary: Decodes 64-bit packed RGBA texture data (four uint16 channels per pixel) into float RGBA. Computes a source pointer from offset 0x18 plus slice/row strides at 0x1050/0x1054, then loops two DWORDs per pixel (this[0x1058] pixels) extracting the four 16-bit channels, scaling each by 0.000015259022, with the first channel decoded via sub_58A870. Writes four floats per output element. When the flag at 0x10 is non-zero, runs ContactManifoldCleanup over the decoded buffer.

operations.description: Compute the source pixel pointer v5 = (DWORD*)(a1[0x18] + a4 * a1[0x1054] + a3 * a1[0x1050]), indexing a row (a3) and slice (a4) into the source data pointer at offset 0x18 using the slice stride 0x1054 and row stride 0x1050.
Iterate v5 from start to v8 = &v5[2 * a1[0x1058]], stepping two DWORDs (four uint16 channels) per pixel for the count at offset 0x1058.
Call sub_58A870 with the low byte of its first argument set to 32, passing the v5[1] word, to produce the first float channel value (unsigned 16-bit result scaled by 0.000015259022).
Extract the remaining three 16-bit channels (HIWORD of v5[1], HIWORD of *v5, LOWORD of *v5) and scale each by 0.000015259022.
Write float RGBA for the pixel (four scaled channels) into a5, advancing a5 by 4 floats per pixel.
Guard on a1[4] (flag at offset 0x10) after the loop restores the original a1 pointer (v7): if non-zero, run the post-process step over the decoded output buffer.
Call ContactManifoldCleanup(a1, buffer-start) where buffer-start is a5 backed up by 4 * a1[0x1058] floats, as the conditional post-process over the decoded RGBA buffer.
